    Site Tools

    Utilities for keeping the Library itself running. Not a room of the archive — the toolbox behind it.

    Change the Gate Passphrase

    The passphrase is the key the whole archive is encrypted with — it isn't checked against a stored value, it unlocks the content directly. Changing it means decrypting everything with the old one and re-encrypting it with the new one. This happens entirely in your browser; nothing here is sent anywhere.

    Because this site has no server, it can't rewrite its own source file. After you run this, copy the result below and send it back so it can be committed into the site — or, if you're comfortable editing on GitHub directly, paste it in place of the long <script id="enc"> block near the end of index.html.

    Build the Full-Site Encrypted Archive

    Right now, only the Root Below the Root door is actually encrypted. Bush Oracle, Bush Girl World, the Loc Adornment Compendium, Jewelry & Belts, Bush Girl Medicine School, Finished Printables, the Living Library Curriculum, Myths of Your Chart, the Grimoire, the Cosmic Roots Almanac, Beneath the Blueprint, and Therapy Notes are only hidden by the page's own styling — the content sits in the page exactly as written, in plain view of anyone who looks at the page source, with no passphrase needed at all.

    This button reads each of those rooms exactly as they stand in this page right now, encrypts all of them together with your gate passphrase, and gives you one block below to copy. Send that block back so it can be committed in place of the plain room content — once that happens, none of it exists anywhere in the page until the passphrase unlocks it. This runs entirely in your browser; nothing here is sent anywhere.
